description: What N GPUs of one model cost for a number of hours at listed rates: at each of the cheapest rate cards and at the median rate card, with the arithmetic. Rental fee only - storage, network egress, taxes and idle time are not counted - and listed rates, not availability.

hours.description: Hours of use; default 730 (a month around the clock).

limit.description: Cheapest rate cards to price; default 5.

region.description: Rates listed in US or EU regions, plus rates that name no region (a provider's rate everywhere); default any.

name: estimate_cost

cite_as.description: How to cite this answer: GPU Economy, the page, the data date.

title: Estimate what a workload costs
